cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Back My Version
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to remember, repeat, and defend one shared version of events when questions begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the committee. We arrived after the greenhouse glass broke, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saw your wheelbarrow hit it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Inside afterwards. We'll say we were clearing up; you can describe that part.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll say that. I won't lie about the wheelbarrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You start with clearing up. I'll answer the barrow questions; I can say we moved it afterwards.
